title: Bayaan sirre Shahadat Ki
body:
Bayan sirre shahadat ki agar tafseer ho jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
1. Musalmano kaa Qibla Rozaa-e-Shabbir ho jaye
<<MINI>>
Bayan sir me shahadat ki agar tafseer ho jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
Gham-e-Shabbir ko chashme muhammad se agar dekhe
kabhibhi bhi majiliso mataam ko tu bidat nahi samje
Tere maslak me jayiz matam-e-shabbir ho jaye
<<MINI>>
Bayan sir me shahadat ki agar tafseer ho jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
2. Sar-e-majlis shahoor aajayenga ansoo bahane kaa
tumharaa dil bhi chaahenga azakhane me jane ka
Tumhare naam bhi firdos ki jageer ho jaye
<<MINI>>
Bayan sir me shahadat ki agar tafseer ho jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
3. Tuje Quran me tathir ki ayat nahi milti
Sabab ye hai ke matam daar se fitrat nahi milti
Nishan matam ka sine per abhi tehrir hojaye
<<MINI>>
Bayan sir me shahadat ki agar tafseer ho jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
4. Janab-e-Hazrat-e-Shabbir ki jo maa hai ay logo
Muhammad ne use khud maa kahaa itna agar socho to Roza Fatema Zehra abhi tameer ho jaye
<<MINI>>
Bayan sir me shahadat ki agar tafseer ho jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
5. Nishan-e-Matam-e-Shabbir hai sadiyon ke sine par
bataaya hazrat
Iqbal aur
<<DIVIDER>>
Rehan
ne mil kar
ho abh khamosh har tehrir har takrir ho jaye
<<MINI>>
Bayan sir me shahadat ki agar tafseer ho jaye
<<DIVIDER>>
x2
